summary: Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR) filed a Form 6-K announcing its board unanimously ratified the suspension of active business operations of its indirect subsidiary PT Walletku Indompet Indonesia due to lack of working capital and forfeiture of its authorized distributor status. The company authorized up to $150,000 from the holding company for severance and debt settlement through September 2026. The action follows a 46.9% revenue decline and $0.45 million net loss for WalletKu in FY2025. The restructuring aims to refocus on an AI Web3 roadmap. No price, premium, or advisor named. Watch for completion of debt settlement and potential further segment shut-downs.
